ns2:section.sectionText: Literacy and Health Care - A Human Factors Perspective: We will explore dimensions of health-related literacy, including how it relates to broader concepts of literacy and cognition, as well as how it is measured. We will also review the literature on who is at risk for low health literacy and its impact on health care (e.g., patient self-care, health resource utilization). Most important, we consider human factors approaches to improving access to health care by patients with low health literacy (e.g., improving document design and provider/patient collaboration).
